core_meaning.primary_meaning: Khatijah is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Pure, Sincere, Compact, Intimate Fri”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Khatijah corresponds to the Arabic form خديجة (Arabic خَدِيجَة (Khadīja)). Its core sense is khadija; a female given name. Khatijah is a South Asian transliteration of Arabic خَدِيجَة (Khadīja), a well-documented female given name borne by Khadija bint Khuwaylid. CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave خاتيجة (a different form) and glossed the name 'Pure, Sincere, Compact, Intimate Fri'; the correct form is خَدِيجَة. Same name as khadeejah, khadejah, khadiga, khadija, khadijah, khadijeh and khatija.

arabic.name: خديجة
arabic.long_meaning: Khatijah (خديجة) اسم مأخوذ من اللغة العربية، ومعناه الأساسي خَدِيجَة (اسم علم مؤنث). يُستخدم هذا الاسم في المجتمعات المسلمة ويختلف استعماله بحسب السياق اللغوي.
